scope: Full native interpreter versus production on retail pl01.anm scripts 19..27 through scheduled interrupt and termination at rates .5/1/1.25: primary color and  sprite, color, layer, resolution flags, active bit, clock, position, scale and extra scale. Native sprite binding and child creation are controlled; all root/child creation requests including repeated script 26 are compared; each script is independently executed with interrupt 1 at frame 301. Native geometry allocation is a controlled buffer; geometry vertices and secondary color are outside this proof. Sprite index is compared after a native binder request; scripts 19 and 25 never bind a sprite, so its initial observer sentinel is excluded. No GPU/pixel or full Bomb-controller equivalence is claimed.
